UI_Intro1: On that day, the world was meant to end in flames. Yet someone's 'justice' defied the purification, and the world was left to warp into this nightmare.
UI_Intro2: Since then, five years have passed. The 'Evolution,' sharpening its fangs in the dark for all this time, now floods onto the surface.
UI_Intro3: This is not a story of keeping hope alive. This is the story of how you evolve... and what you will ultimately become.
UI_NE_Start_1: ...I feel like I've been in a long, dark dream. ...My body is burning. Something is wrong.
UI_NE_Start_2: ...I recognize this corpse. Dr. Hiro? ...But why is it so decayed...?
UI_NE_Start_3: ...*Cough, hack!!* ...I cut my throat deep when I pulled out that mysterious IV!
UI_NE_Start_4: I was supposed to be evacuated from the airport. ...So why am I here?
UI_NE_Start_5: ...To find out what's happening to my body, I have to go to that military research facility. Maybe there's a clue in this lab coat?
UI_NE_Card_Reminder: ...I can't leave yet. I have to search Dr. Hiro's lab coat...
UI_NE_Card_Reminder_Dist: The doctor's body should have the key and documents. I have to go back and look...
UI_NE_Card_Reminder_Wake: I had a dream about that doctor... I feel like I have to go back and get the key and documents.
UI_NE_Phase_2: ...Something has begun to tremble deep inside my body.
UI_NE_Phase_3: The world is creaking. There's no turning back now.
UI_NE_Phase_4: The bells of ending are tolling. It's the time of judgment.
UI_Sandbox_DaysToAirstrike_tooltip: Days until the military airstrike (Game Over). This is the basis for phase transition calculations.
UI_Sandbox_InstinctVoice_tooltip: Allows the character's internal thoughts to be displayed on screen.
UI_NE_Speech_Mutation_Clean_1: Today my body feels a little lighter. ...If only this could stay 'normal.'
UI_NE_Speech_Mutation_Clean_2: I take a deep breath. ...The air doesn't choke me yet.
UI_NE_Speech_Mutation_Clean_3: I picture Dr. Hiro's face. ...Was he really trying to save me?
UI_NE_Speech_Mutation_Clean_4: Only my footsteps echo. ...Still, I feel alive.
UI_NE_Speech_Mutation_Clean_5: I press on the wound. ...The blood still stops. This is still a human body.
UI_NE_Speech_Mutation_Clean_6: ...The fear feels far away for a moment. ...I wish it could stay this calm.
UI_NE_Speech_Mutation_Clean_7: I drink water. The taste is clear. I'm grateful for that.
UI_NE_Speech_Mutation_Clean_8: I want to see someone. ...If I did, what would I even say?
UI_NE_Speech_Mutation_Clean_9: Yesterday's me and today's me. ...I still feel like they're connected.
UI_NE_Speech_Mutation_Clean_10: ...I'll keep walking. Even just for one day, straight ahead.
UI_NE_Speech_Mutation_Unstable_1: Something is squirming under my skin. ...I'm scared. This is still my body, right?
UI_NE_Speech_Mutation_Unstable_2: I'm afraid to look in the mirror. I feel like my eye color is changing, bit by bit.
UI_NE_Speech_Mutation_Unstable_3: My fingertips are trembling. ...It's like someone else's hand is trying to move on its own.
UI_NE_Speech_Mutation_Unstable_4: This metallic taste in the back of my throat. ...Is something dissolving inside me?
UI_NE_Speech_Mutation_Unstable_5: The ringing in my ears won't stop. ...I feel like someone's calling my name. But there's no one here.
UI_NE_Speech_Mutation_Unstable_6: Strange colored fluid is oozing from under my nails. ...Am I sick? Is it something terminal?
UI_NE_Speech_Mutation_Unstable_7: Every now and then, I hear my heartbeat twice. ...It's like something else is pulsing inside me.
UI_NE_Speech_Mutation_Unstable_8: My body feels heavy. ...I can't shake this hideous urge to shed my own skin.
UI_NE_Speech_Mutation_Unstable_9: The hair on my arms is standing up in unnatural directions. ...Why? There's no wind.
UI_NE_Speech_Mutation_Unstable_10: ...Mom. Help me. I think something's wrong with me.
UI_NE_Speech_Mutation_Danger_1: I hear my bones creaking. ...It hurts. Am I being reshaped? Into what? Why me...?
UI_NE_Speech_Mutation_Danger_2: The world feels wrong. Everything looks sharper, but that only makes it more terrifying.
UI_NE_Speech_Mutation_Danger_3: My heart feels heavy. Thump, thump... Is this even a human heartbeat?
UI_NE_Speech_Mutation_Danger_4: My sense of taste is broken. ...Food I used to love tastes like sand. ...But the smell of soil... it smells sweet.
UI_NE_Speech_Mutation_Danger_5: My wounds are healing unnaturally fast. I should be happy, but... it makes me want to cry from fear.
UI_NE_Speech_Mutation_Danger_6: I can run without catching my breath at all. ...Where is my heart getting this kind of power?
UI_NE_Speech_Mutation_Danger_7: ...The face in the mirror. ...Who is it? Who is this lifeless, monster-like person!?
UI_NE_Speech_Mutation_Danger_8: I can't remember words properly. ...Simple terms vanish just as I'm about to say them.
UI_NE_Speech_Mutation_Danger_9: My hair falls out in clumps when I touch it. ...Something harder is growing underneath.
UI_NE_Speech_Mutation_Danger_10: ...I'm still human, right? ...Please, someone tell me I am.
UI_NE_Speech_Mutation_Critical_1: The air hurts. ...How can I feel more comfortable in this pollution? I'm losing my mind.
UI_NE_Speech_Mutation_Critical_2: The texture of my skin has changed. ...It's rough, cold. Will I ever be human again?
UI_NE_Speech_Mutation_Critical_3: The blood in my veins isn't red anymore. ...It's dark... some kind of unknown fluid.
UI_NE_Speech_Mutation_Critical_4: I miss people. ...But if I met someone, would I just see them as 'food'? The thought terrifies me.
UI_NE_Speech_Mutation_Critical_5: I'm tired of thinking. ...I just want to forget everything. Who I was, everything.
UI_NE_Speech_Mutation_Critical_6: Everything is turning green. ...It's beautiful. ...No! I shouldn't think it's beautiful!
UI_NE_Speech_Mutation_Critical_7: My lungs are rejecting normal air. ...This poison-like mist is the only thing that feels right now.
UI_NE_Speech_Mutation_Critical_8: ...My consciousness is fading. ...I feel like someone is knocking on my brain from the inside.
UI_NE_Speech_Mutation_Critical_9: ...Where am I going? ...Am I going to die? Or will I be turned into something even worse?
UI_NE_Speech_Mutation_Critical_10: Dr. Hiro... I can hear your voice... ...Shut up! Leave me alone!!
UI_NE_Speech_Mutation_EVOLVED_1: ...I'm not afraid anymore. I've come this far.
UI_NE_Speech_Mutation_EVOLVED_2: My heartbeat matches the world's rhythm. ...Is this what 'next' feels like?
UI_NE_Speech_Mutation_EVOLVED_3: Dr. Hiro. ...Is this the 'evolution' you wanted?
UI_NE_Speech_Mutation_EVOLVED_4: Pain feels like a blessing. ...Did I break, or did I finish?
UI_NE_Speech_Mutation_EVOLVED_5: ...In the silence, my own voice sounds holy. I should find that absurd.
UI_NE_Speech_Mutation_EVOLVED_6: I can't remember my human name anymore. ...I don't need it.
UI_NE_Speech_Mutation_EVOLVED_7: This body isn't a cage anymore. ...It feels like wings.
UI_NE_Speech_Mutation_EVOLVED_8: ...The fog feels like it's kneeling to me. Or is that just how I see it?
UI_NE_Speech_Mutation_EVOLVED_9: It's not the end. ...It's the beginning. I want to believe that.
UI_NE_Speech_Mutation_EVOLVED_10: ...Goodbye, weak me. From here on, I walk my own path.
UI_NE_Speech_Weather_Rain_1: The sound of rain. ...Strange. My body feels this cold water as 'pain' now.
UI_NE_Speech_Weather_Rain_2: I wish the rain could wash everything away. This abnormality growing inside me too.
UI_NE_Speech_Weather_Rain_3: Drops of purification. ...But to me now, even this rain feels like poison.
UI_NE_Speech_Weather_Fog_1: Fog. ...I want to hide in this whiteness. I don't want anyone to see what I've become.
UI_NE_Speech_Weather_Fog_2: A white-out world. ...The same color as that cold gas I saw on B17 that day.
UI_NE_Speech_Weather_Storm_1: Thunder. ...The world is angry. Angry at this fate that created a freak like me.
UI_NE_Speech_Weather_Snow_1: Snow. ...Cold and quiet. ...I can see my hot body temperature staining the snow.
UI_NE_Speech_Loc_Lab_1: The smell of chemicals. ...Coming back here brings back the nausea of those five years of darkness.
UI_NE_Speech_Loc_Lab_2: Dr. Hiro... What did you think of me? Was I just a piece of experimental material to you?
UI_NE_Speech_Loc_City_1: An empty city. ...Sometimes I look back, thinking I heard someone laughing. But there's no one.
UI_NE_Speech_Loc_City_2: A shattered shop window. Who's the person in the mirror? ...Oh, it's me.
UI_NE_Speech_Loc_Home_1: Someone's house. ...There was a 'daily life' here once, wasn't there? ...It's too bright for me now.
UI_NE_Speech_Loc_Road_1: A long, long road. ...Where am I going? Am I just running away?
UI_NE_Speech_Loc_Forest_1: The forest. ...I feel like the trees are rejecting me. I've become an enemy of nature.
UI_NE_Speech_Despair_1: ...I should have burned with the base that day. Before I knew this kind of loneliness.
UI_NE_Speech_Despair_2: Is the world like this because I stopped the nuke? ...Did everyone die because of me?
UI_NE_Speech_Despair_3: Help me. Anyone, please answer. ...Am I really the only one left in this wide world?
UI_NE_Speech_Despair_4: I can't remember my name from yesterday. ...Bit by bit, I'm being chipped away. Where am I going?
UI_NE_Speech_Despair_5: ...I looked in the mirror, and something that wasn't human was smiling. ...Is that me?
UI_NE_Speech_Despair_6: ...I'm hungry. ...But no matter what I eat, it only tastes like sand and ash.
UI_NE_Speech_Despair_7: There is no salvation. ...I'm just being kept alive as a seed for monsters.
UI_NE_Speech_Despair_8: ...Would it be easier if I just died? ...But I'm too much of a coward to even do that.
UI_NE_Speech_Despair_9: ...God. If you're watching, please stop toy with me. ...Just let me sleep in peace.
UI_NE_Speech_Despair_10: ...I'm tired now. ...I want to end it all.
UI_NE_Speech_Combat_Berserk_1: Stop! My body is moving on its own! ...No, I don't want to do this!!
UI_NE_Speech_Combat_Berserk_2: ...Aaargh!! My mind is going blank! I'm tearing myself apart from the inside!
UI_NE_Speech_Combat_Berserk_3: Someone help me...! I'm trying to kill myself! I can't stop it!!
UI_NE_Speech_Combat_Berserk_4: ...The blood. ...It's warm. ...No, I don't want to think it tastes good...!!
UI_NE_Speech_Combat_Berserk_5: Destroy! ...No, don't! I'm... I'm still human!!
UI_NE_Speech_Recovery_1: ...Hah. ...What was I... Thank goodness, I'm still 'me'...
UI_NE_Speech_Recovery_2: My vision cleared a bit. ...I'm scared. It's like there's an unknown monster living inside me.
UI_NE_Speech_Recovery_3: ...I'm still human. ...Right? I can still be human, right?
UI_NE_Speech_Recovery_4: Breathing is easier now. ...It feels like I've escaped from that sweet, terrifying temptation, for now.
UI_NE_Speech_Happy_1: ...Oh. This can of food is still good. ...I'm so happy. ...I'm glad I'm alive, just for a moment.
UI_NE_Speech_Happy_2: I found a beautiful piece of cloth. ...It feels like forever since I've seen a human-like color.
UI_NE_Speech_Happy_3: ...The rain stopped. ...The sun is a little warm. ...Thank you.
UI_NE_Speech_Happy_4: A soft pillow. ...Maybe I can have a good dream tonight.
UI_NE_Speech_Happy_5: ...The sound of birds. ...At least they're still singing the same as the old world.
UI_NE_Speech_Happy_6: Delicious water. ...Pure water flowing down my parched throat. ...I'm happy.
UI_NE_Speech_Happy_7: ...A quiet night. ...Maybe I can avoid having bad dreams just for tonight.
UI_NE_Speech_Happy_8: ...A sweater someone knitted. ...It's warm. It's like human warmth is still here.
UI_NE_Speech_Happy_9: ...An old record. ...The music mixed with static calms my heart, just a little.
UI_NE_Speech_Happy_10: ...I'm still alive. ...I should be thankful for just that, shouldn't I?
UI_NE_Speech_Memory_1: ...My mother's voice. ...What did it sound like? ...I want to remember, but the noise gets in the way.
UI_NE_Speech_Memory_2: Five years. ...Give me back the five years of my life. Why did it have to be me...
UI_NE_Speech_Memory_3: My old friends. ...Where did you all go? Leaving me behind, where?
UI_NE_Speech_Memory_4: A birthday cake. ...I'll probably never smell that sweet scent again for the rest of my life.
UI_NE_Speech_Memory_5: "You will be a hero"... Dr. Hiro said. ...Doctor, is this your answer?
UI_NE_Speech_Internal_1: Who's there...? Is someone in my head? Who's watching me from the inside?
UI_NE_Speech_Internal_2: I have to kick them out. ...But if I do, I feel like half of me will be gone.
UI_NE_Speech_Internal_3: My brain is shaking. ...It's being rewritten. ...My will isn't reaching my fingertips anymore.
UI_NE_Speech_Internal_4: ...Oh, it's so comfortable. ...It would be so much easier if I just gave up. ...No! I can't give up!
UI_NE_Speech_Sensory_1: ...I can hear it. The sound of something crawling miles away. ...No, I don't want to hear it.
UI_NE_Speech_Sensory_2: In the wind, it's mixed in. ...The scent of blood, decay, and something even more hideous.
UI_NE_Speech_Sensory_3: I feel like the ground is pulsing. ...It's as if the whole world has become one giant stomach.
UI_NE_Speech_Reflection_1: ...Dr. Hiro. You called me an evolution. ...But this is just 'collapse'.
UI_NE_Speech_Reflection_2: ...God. If you're watching, please don't toy with me anymore. ...Just let me sleep in peace.
UI_NE_Speech_Reflection_3: Justice was just a word game. ...What I did that day was nothing but arrogance.
UI_NE_Speech_Reflection_4: The world is over. ...All that's left is our corpses.
